fusions.name: Raking Hindlegs
fusions.desc: Rakes the target with both hind feet for 4 damage and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mad Half-Minute
fusions.desc: Tears around clawing every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 7 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Soft-Footed Slink
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Lucky Ninth
fusions.desc: Once every 300 seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
